{"id":1616934224,"question_id":2856,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 2 months","timestamp":1745520413,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"17 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1616934224/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Complete Subarrays in an Array","memory":"41.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countCompleteSubarrays(vector<int>& nums) {\n        unordered_set<int>st;\n        //getting the number of distinct elements\n        for(auto num : nums)\n        {\n            st.insert(num);\n        }\n        int total_distinct = st.size();\n\n        //calculating the complete subarrays\n        int curr_distinct = 0;\n        int left = 0 ;\n        int right = 0;\n        int completed = 0;\n\n        unordered_map<int,int>mp;\n\n        while(right < nums.size())\n        {\n            //adding the element in the map for checks \n            mp[nums[right]] ++;\n\n            //check until the distinct elements are still present in the subarray\n            while(mp.size() == total_distinct)\n            {\n                completed += nums.size() - right;\n                //shrink the window\n                mp[nums[left]] --;\n                if(mp[nums[left]] == 0)\n                {\n                    mp.erase(nums[left]);\n                }\n                left ++;\n            }\n            right ++;\n        }\n        return completed;  \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-complete-subarrays-in-an-array","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":573}
